metadata.case_name: NAZIR BEGUM DIN AND OTHERS v. LEE KWEI YING, PEGGY AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: clerical and general office/receptionist; part time for her husband's pest control business (general office duties)
plaintiff.occupation_after: has not worked since the accident

injuries.description: scarring in her brain tissue / abnormal brain wave abnormality
source: In view of the E.E.G. changes it seems that Mrs Din has to be maintained on medication probably for the rest of her life as the abnormal brain waves appear to be due to scarring in her brain tissue and is likely to be something of a permanent nature.
injuries.icd_description: Epilepsy due to injuries to the head

injuries.description: a fracture of the left transverse process L5
source: a fracture of the left transverse process L5.

injuries.description: a fracture of the left pubic rami of the pelvis
source: a fracture of the left pubic rami of the pelvis;
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of pubis without disruption of pelvic ring

injuries.description: a communited fracture of the right fibula and tibia
source: a communited fracture of the right fibula and tibia;
Miss Din suffered grievous injury in this accident. ... Miss Din suffered from lacerations of the abdominal wall, degloving injuries of both legs and a compound fracture of the left fibula.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of abdomen, lower back or pelvis
Other specified open wound of knee or lower leg

injuries.description: a compound fracture of the left fibula
source: and a compound fracture of the left fibula.

injuries.description: a subtrochanteric fracture of the left femur
source: The fractures included a subtrochanteric fracture of the left femur

injuries.description: a fracture-separation of the lower left tibia and fibular epiphyses with dislocation of the left ankle
source: a fracture-separation of the lower left tibia and fibular epiphyses with dislocation of the left ankle;
injuries.icd_description: Multiple injuries of ankle or foot

manifestations.description: "She is in constant pain, as she says, she "has pain always". The pain is in the back and is worse after copulation."
"Swelling and numbness of the upper part of the left thigh."
"When she bends forward she gets pain, she cannot sit for too long and when she stands, she gets pain in the low back. She will lean on a wall to relieve this pain."

"A scar of 5½ inches long from the operation on the front of the right leg with stitch marks on both sides is easily visible in good light at a distance of about 10 to 18 feet. The scar is dark red in colour. No significant change is expected to occur in the future as far as the colour is concerned. In fact the scar will definitely look worse after a second operation to remove the bone plate. The right leg is also noticeably thicker as a result of callus formation at the fracture ends. This cosmetic disability will persist for years and may be permanent."
"She has lapsed into a state of severe depression."
"There was still the presence of localized abnormality over both temporo-occipital regions, particularly over the left side."

"The idea of living with the pain in her back, the permanent disfigurement as inflicted by the accident and repeated surgery for the rest of her life, made her so depressed as to lose interest in herself and her own well-being and she made no effort to watch what she ate and began to put on weight"
"total void of interests in sex since her accident."

"The greater part of the medial and anterior surfaces of the left leg from just below the knee to the ankle and the whole of the lateral side of the ankle were denuded of skin exposing muscles and deeper structures. The whole of the posterior surface of the right leg from the knee to a short distance above the ankle was also denuded of skin."
"A great part of the calf muscle of that leg was also lost."

"On the lateral aspect of the leg and down most of the back of the calf there is conspicious deformity and disfigurement from skin and subcutaneous tissue loss which has been replaced by pigmented skin grafts which are adherent to the underlying muscle and conspicously pucker when the muscle contracts."
"Leg length - this is difficult to measure ... but we think that she may be about ½ inch longer on the left side" / "The scanogram shows that she is 2 cm. shorter on the right to the left."
"She is now a fit healthy child with some aches in her left leg, exacerbated by damp weather."

treatments_received: orthopaedic surgery (reduction and fixation with metal plate for tibia/fibula)
spinal fusion operations (two failed fusion operations)
plastic surgery / skin grafting (extensive excision and skin grafting to both legs)
open reduction and internal fixation for femur fracture
removal of metal plate (left femur) and excision of unsightly scar
treatments_future: long term psychiatric assistance / supportive psychotherapy
maintenance on anti-convulsant drugs (probably for the rest of her life) for Mrs Din
monitoring of Fahimah's ankle and probable future orthopaedic operation for valgus ankle (assessed as a probability; Dr Hsu gave 50/50 chance during growth spurt)
possible corrective surgery for ankle in future (for Fahimah)

losses.description: Unsightly scar on right leg: "A scar of 5½ inches long from the operation on the front of the right leg ... The scar is dark red in colour ... This cosmetic disability will persist for years and may be permanent."

Cannot bend, forced to wear an orthopaedic corset, cannot wear high heels, limited ability to do housework and physical activities: "She cannot bend. She cooks only rarely and then only if she is seated at the stove ... She has not worked since the accident"

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Reduced ability to do ordinary household activities; requires part-time/full-time amah assistance: "She could do only a very limited amount of housework ... She is forced to wear an orthopaedic corset."

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: "total void of interests in sex since her accident" leading to marital and sexual problems
Change in personality and appearance; severe depression and irritability: "She has lapsed into a state of severe depression"; "her personality and appearance have both changed."
Does not see friends, rarely talks to them and avoids social activities: "She does not see her friends and rarely talks to them on the telephone."

Extensive permanent scarring and deformity of both lower limbs: "...conspicious deformity and disfigurement from skin and subcutaneous tissue loss..." leading to embarrassment, teasing and abandonment of activities (e.g. ballet).

Reduced endurance and some difficulty walking distances and climbing stairs; aches in left leg especially in damp weather: "She is now physically capable of taking part in a range of physical activity but her endurance is clearly less than a normal child of her age."

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Abandonment of ballet after teasing and reduced ability to participate in some sports; impact on hobbies and schooling activities.

Loss of future earning capacity / potential future loss of earnings due to scarring, need for future operations and time off work (global award made): awarded $60,000 for future earning capacity for Fahimah Din.
